body_markdown:
Reviewers speak to underwire that doesn't dig. Carmella (38C) says "the wire does not dig and has good coverage." J S., a 38DDD/F, describes "all the comfort you expect from Honeylove with all the support of a wire bra." Melinda, who says she's 72, calls it the first underwire where she isn't being cut into underneath.


The sides and back read smooth under clothes. Maria (36C) reports no bulges and a smooth silhouette with straps that stay put. Coleen P. likes "the higher sides (under arms)." Cathy, a 32DD/E, says it looks great under all types of clothing. Fuller cups get support too: an anonymous 42DD(E) reviewer calls it "soft, supportive and no ride up in the back," and Linda (40DD/E) says it's comfortable and supportive.


Best for readers who need underwire structure and want the same raw-cut, bonded side smoothing as Honeylove's wireless bras, especially under fitted dresses and workwear.


## #3 Felina Marvelous Side Smoothing T-Shirt Bra: Best underwire side smoothing bra under $60


Side smoothing is in this bra's name and it's the most praised feature in its reviews.


Felina


builds dedicated side and back smoothing panels onto a traditional underwire T-shirt bra, adds a moisture-wicking power mesh band, and uses a leotard-style back that keeps straps from slipping outward. It's the mid-priced, conventional-construction option: a classic underwire bra with a side panel added, rather than a bra rebuilt around the side.


**Features and pricing:**


-


$52; bands 32–42, cups B, C, D, DD, DDD, G


-


Underwire with lightly padded velvet-touch foam cups


-


Side and back smoothing panels for underarm and back coverage


-


Moisture-wicking power mesh band


-


Leotard-back design to prevent strap slippage, fully adjustable straps, hook-and-eye closure


-


Cups 78% nylon / 22% spandex; band 70% nylon / 30% spandex


The dominant review theme is side smoothing that works. Chloe H. found it while hunting for a bigger cup and credits "the side smoothing function, the thick 3 hooks at the back and the fit and lift," then bought three more. Michelle L. likes the side support too. Fuller-cup reviewers show up in force. Gwendolyn B. (38G, 5'7") says the side smoothing is perfect and the band feels great "even after wearing for 20 hours straight." Lori G. (38DD) calls it the first bra she's had with no spillage.


**The trade-offs are worth knowing before you order:**


-


It runs small. Reviewers regularly size up in the band. Gwendolyn B. went up one band size, and Melissa W. is on her third exchange after her usual size came in too small. Consider ordering one band size up.


-


The side panel can rub on smaller torsos, with 26 critical mentions of rubbing or digging. Arianna F. says the fabric "cuts into my armpits" and notes a very small torso; Allison J. says it cut into the skin between the strap and armpit. That's the same wing-height lesson as the CrossOver.


-


A few reviewers report the mesh sides stretching after a few wears, or the wire shifting on heavier busts.


Best for readers who prefer traditional underwire and want a dedicated side panel at a mid-range price, especially fuller cups up to G. Consider sizing up one band.


## #4 Warner's No Side Effects Underarm-Smoothing Wireless Bra: Best budget wireless side smoothing bra


This is the accessible department-store pick built specifically around underarm smoothing.


Warner's


removes elastic from the sides and back, since the elastic edge is what usually presses a line into the side, and adds side-smoothing panels to a lightly lined wireless cup. It's the practical, lower-cost option if you want to test whether side smoothing solves your problem before spending more, or you just want an everyday rotation bra.


**Features and pricing:**


-


$46 list, frequently discounted at Kohl's and Macy's; bands 34–48, cups A–DD


-


Wireless with flexible foam cups, lightly lined


-


Elastic-free sides and back, plus side-smoothing panels for the underarm


-


Front-adjustable straps, tag-free, hook-and-eye closure


The sides are the story in the reviews. LA K calls it the "Best T-shirt bra! I love the extra side support!" MP10 reports "no side bulge like others have." Nep1, who's over 65, likes the wide sides and notes the band underneath stays flat and doesn't roll. It reads smooth under thin tops, too. One long-time owner says it's smooth enough to wear under the thinnest tops without showing, and Terricharb says the side panels don't dig in at all. Repeat buying shows up across 73 positive reviews.


**Two trade-offs stand out:**


-


Sizing is inconsistent between purchases, with 20-plus critical mentions. Cathie reordered the same style and size she loved the year before and it "turned out it was way too tight!!"


-


Support can fade over a long day. SheRN says it fit nicely in the morning but sagged by the end of her shift with the straps falling off. Jstate says the underarm smoothing starts to cut in after two hours.


Best for readers who want wireless underarm smoothing at the lowest price on this list, with lighter support needs, ideally bought in store where the fit can be checked.


## #5 Playtex 18 Hour Side & Back Smoothing Wireless Bra: Best full-coverage side smoothing for bands 36+


This is the long-running full-coverage wirefree option, built for fuller band sizes. Side and back smoothing is worked into the band, the sleek 2-ply non-foam cups keep a no-show look, and Playtex's


TruSUPPORT


spreads four-way support across the cups, sides, back, and straps. Many readers already know it, which is part of the appeal.


**Features and pricing:**


-


$43 list, often around $20 on sale; bands 36–46, cups B–DDD


-


Wirefree with sleek 2-ply non-foam cups and moisture-wicking cup fabric


-


Built-in side and back smoothing


-


Cushioned, non-slip Comfort Straps and TruSUPPORT four-way support


Loyalty and comfort run through the reviews. Mary Pete says she has been buying this bra for 30 years and ordered three when she found it again. Wire-free lift for fuller cups draws 43 positive mentions from 38D and up. Juli Anne (38DD) says it lifts incredibly without an underwire and doesn't ride up in the back. Side shaping gets its own praise, with LindaD calling it comfortable with good side shaping and Cretty naming the side and back smoothing as what she loves.


**The honest trade-offs:**


-


It runs small and tight, with 49 mentions and 40 of them critical. Lymanbek says it's "super tight and hard to fasten," and Michelle P. found her usual size so tight she could only wear it a few hours. Size up in the band.


-


Cup support is lighter than some expect, across 23 mentions. Even fans admit the cups aren't as supportive as some others.


Best for readers in bands 36–46 who want full coverage and side smoothing without a wire at a drugstore price. Size up if you're between bands.


## #6 Leonisa High Profile Back Smoothing Bra: Best for maximum underarm coverage


This is the highest-coverage underwire in the roundup. Coverage runs high in the cups, under the arms, and across the back, with a longline


PowerSlim underband


and flexible side boning. It's the pick if your main goal is covering as much of the underarm-to-back zone as possible and you're comfortable with underwire.


**Features and pricing:**


-


$60; bands 34–40, cups B, C, D, DD/E


-


Underwire with soft full-coverage foam cups


-


High coverage under the arms and across the back


-


Longline PowerSlim underband for a smooth line under clothing


-


Flexible side boning and a 4-level adjustable hook-and-eye closure


Side and back coverage anchors the reviews, with more than 200 mentions. Isabella Mulwani says it doesn't create visible lumps on her side like thin-banded bras do, so she wears it under tight basic tops. INALIZ (36D) says it "covers the entire part under the arm," and B.R. loves the extra-wide side band. Fuller-bust comfort comes up as well. Celia (38D) says it doesn't dig into her shoulders and ordered a second color. Carla writes that after years of searching she found one that supports and smooths both back and sides.


**The honest trade-offs:**


-


It runs slightly large. Erin Printz-Collins, typically a 38D, sized to a 36C and still found it slightly large. INALIZ fastened on the last hook in a 36D and could have gone to a 34. There's no 32 band.


-


Most negative feedback centers on comfort, with one-star reviewers saying it's uncomfortable or doesn't hold shape. One reviewer couldn't keep it on longer than a couple of hours.


Best for readers who want the most coverage at the underarm and back, with underwire support, in bands 34–40. Consider sizing down in the band.


## Honeylove has a side smoothing bra for every frame


Side smoothing comes from the wing and the side seam: how tall it is, how wide it is, and how well it's reinforced. The wing also has to fit your torso. Every brand's reviews in this list say the same thing, which is why a single "best" side smoothing bra doesn't exist.


**Here's how the Honeylove picks sort out:**


-


The


[CrossOver](https://www.honeylove.com/products/crossover-bra) gives the most underarm coverage in a wireless bra, with flexible side boning that keeps the wing flat and upright.


-


The


[CloudEmbrace with CloudWire](https://www.honeylove.com/products/cloudembrace-bra-with-cloudwire) adds foam-wrapped underwire lift without giving up raw-cut, bonded sides.


Use Honeylove's


[sizing tool](https://www.honeylove.com/answers/how-do-i-find-my-correct-size) to match your measurements to a style, then lean on free 30-day returns and exchanges to try the fit at home.


## Side smoothing bras FAQs


### What makes a bra side smoothing?


Side smoothing comes from the wing, the piece that extends from the cup around your sides. A wing that's wide enough to cover the underarm, reinforced enough to stay upright, and finished with a raw-cut or bonded edge lies flat instead of pressing a ridge into your skin. That combination is what smooths the side, not a bigger cup.


### Why does my bra dig into my armpits?


Usually the wing is too tall for your torso, so its top edge lands in the armpit crease and cuts in when you move. Reviewers with shorter or smaller torsos describe this across several bras in this list. A lower-profile wing, or one sized to your frame, fixes it.


### Are wireless bras good for side support?


They can be, when the side is built for it. The CrossOver pairs wide wings with flexible side boning that holds the panel upright, and reviewers in cups up to E say it stays put without folding at the sides. Support at the side comes from the panel structure, not from a wire.


### Should I size up if the sides of my bra show?


Not necessarily. Going up a cup or down a band often trades side spillage for gaping cups or a band that digs. Tissue showing at the side is usually a wing-construction and wing-height issue, so a bra with a taller, reinforced wing that fits your torso is the better fix.
